info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector DataLakeStoreAccounts API
Microsoft Azure Get Subscriptions Subscriptionid Resourcegroups Resourcegroupname Providers Microsoft Datalakeanalytics Accounts Accountname Datalakestoreaccounts

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Get subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the Azure resource group.

params.name: accountName
params.description: The name of the Data Lake Analytics account.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter. Optional.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of items to return. Optional.

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of items to skip over before returning elements. Optional.

params.name: $select
params.description: OData Select statement. Limits the properties on each entry to just those requested, e.g. Categories?$select=CategoryName,Description. Optional.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: OrderBy clause. One or more comma-separated expressions with an optional "asc" (the default) or "desc" depending on the order you'd like the values sorted, e.g. Categories?$orderby=CategoryName desc. Optional.

params.name: $count
params.description: The Boolean value of true or false to request a count of the matching resources included with the resources in the response, e.g. Categories?$count=true. Optional.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Client Api Version.

items.docs: Gets the first page of Data Lake Store accounts linked to the specified Data Lake Analytics account. The response includes a link to the next page, if any.
